newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RED-CARD KING MAKES BRIEF RETURN BEFORE VANISHING AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RED-CARD KING MAKES BRIEF RETURN BEFORE VANISHING AGAIN.

text.p: Dundee play-maker Chic Charnley, who has been sent off 15 times in his career -- will make a welcome -- if brief -- return to action for his team in their Scottish league cup semifinal against Hearts on Wednesday night.

Because Charnley, who 10 days ago was sent off for the fifteenth time and was suspended from Saturday's league defeat at Partick, will also be suspended for the following four matches after Wednesday.
Besides having had more scrapes with authority than most players, hot-headed Charnley is also a highly talented player.
Besides the fact he won't be able to use him much for the next few weeks, Dundee boss Jim Duffy praised him on Monday.

"Chic has been important for us since he came here and there is no doubt he makes us play at times. He has done well for us in this competition and it is good that he is available for the semi-final."
Dundee were beaten in the final of this competition last season by Aberdeen.
